blocks.name: register_file
blocks.responsibility: Implements 32 32-bit integer registers with asynchronous reads, synchronous writes, asynchronous active-high reset, and hardwired-zero x0.
blocks.design_rationale: Isolates architectural state for straightforward verification of reset behavior, asynchronous operand reads, and suppression of writes to x0.

blocks.name: immediate_decoder
blocks.responsibility: Combinationally extracts and sign-extends the I, S, B, and J immediates and extracts the U immediate from a 32-bit instruction.
blocks.design_rationale: Centralizes immediate bit mapping, making control-flow offsets and load/store addresses independently verifiable.

blocks.name: rv32im_alu
blocks.responsibility: Performs RV32I integer register and immediate arithmetic, shifts, comparisons, and logic, plus all RV32M multiply, divide, and remainder operations, including defined divide-by-zero and signed-overflow results.
blocks.design_rationale: Groups arithmetic and RV32M datapath operations behind one combinational interface, simplifying operation-level verification and keeping instruction-cycle execution single-cycle.

blocks.name: cpu
blocks.responsibility: Top-level monociclo RV32IM processor. Exposes the specified instruction and data buses; fetches and decodes instructions; selects register operands and immediates; controls register writes, loads, stores, branches, JAL, and JALR; and updates the PC on each rising clock edge.
blocks.design_rationale: Integrates the state, immediate, and execution blocks while preserving the exact external contract and making instruction sequencing and memory-bus behavior verifiable at the top level.

notes: Use only ieee.std_logic_1164 and ieee.numeric_std. The CPU must expose the current PC on instr_addr, keep data_addr as the unmasked effective byte address, select and extend load data according to the address offset, and assert data_write only for stores.
